title: The Spirit's descent and the two fires of Christ's baptism
english: The Spirit also comes down upon the apostles. For the Spirit is God, and God is a consuming fire. This is why Christ is said to baptize with fire: because he poured out the grace of Christ upon his holy disciples in the form of fiery tongues, or because of the punishing nature of the fire to come. That final baptism is not saving, but destructive of evil—for no longer will evil and sin hold sway—yet the fire punishes endlessly.
